questions.stem: A 25-year-old male presents to the emergency department after being involved in a bar fight. He has a notable swelling on the upper part of his right ear. On examination, the swelling is fluctuant, non-pulsatile, and tender to touch. There is no overlying skin laceration. His vital signs are stable, and the rest of the examination is unremarkable. What is the most appropriate next step in the management of this patient's ear condition?
